extDescription.message: See the real local time of WhatsApp Web contacts (and each group member) living in another time zone.

sameTime.description: Offset label when the zone matches the user's

nextDayShort.description: Appended to a message time that falls on the next day for them

previousDayShort.description: Appended to a message time that falls on the previous day for them

messageTimeTitle.description: Tooltip on a message's local time

badgeTitleGuessed.message: Time zone guessed from the phone number: click to set it

panelTitleContact.description: Panel title in a one-to-one chat

panelNoMembers.message: Members appear once the group header lists them.

pickerSet.description: Zone picker button when no zone is known

pickerAutomatic.description: Zone picker item that clears the manual zone

popupIntro.message: Click the clock in a chat header to set where people live.

popupPerMessageDescription.message: Show their time next to each message, e.g. 17:48 (23:48).

popupEmptyDescription.message: Open a chat on web.whatsapp.com and click the clock next to the search icon.
